second_update_profile.interpretation: One large second-update tail, not a general throughput estimate. Most sampled cost is in the transaction thread on growth-gate reclaim page probes; no reclaim/identity/LSA check was removed.

initial.test_options: UNIT_TEST_OOS=ON for correctness only; profiling artifacts remain test-OFF
initial.prototype: common_loop plus lazy OOS writer plan and reused read header; allocator unchanged; no lifetime instrumentation

correctness.initial_outcome: 13/15; test_oos_identity_stamp and test_oos_server timed out at unchanged60sec limits
correctness.filtered_native_error_test: passed; expected error case4214ms; separate profile showed addr2line/libbfd work

system_symbolizer_run.change: Only addr2line resolves to /usr/bin/addr2line through a task-local PATH prefix. Engine source, binaries, suite selection and timeouts unchanged.
